title: kb_mcp leaves out every mcp_tools tool of a group whose name has a hyphen, a name kbext.py init-team accepts
goal: kb_mcp.py serves a group's mcp_tools under a prefix for every group name kbext.GROUP_NAME_RE accepts (single hyphens included), the prefix a valid MCP tool name, and extending.md states the prefix rule

run:
import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
T=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
def W(p,v):
    p=pathlib.Path(p); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_text(v if isinstance(v,str) else json.dumps(v),encoding="utf-8"); return p
def need(c,m):
    if not c: sys.exit("not yet: "+str(m)[:800])
def R(*a,env=None):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(os.environ,**(env or {})),timeout=600)
EXT='KBEXT_REQUIRES = ">=0.1"\n'
e=T/"ext"; W(e/"gt.py",EXT+"def hello(args):\n    return 'hi'\nTOOLS=[{'name':'hello','description':'say hi','inputSchema':{'type':'object','properties':{}},'call':hello}]\n")
W(T/"settings.json",{"group":"acme-corp","extensions":{"mcp_tools":"gt:TOOLS"},"extension_paths":[str(e)]})
os.environ["CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"]=str(T)
import kbext
need(kbext.GROUP_NAME_RE.fullmatch("acme-corp"), "GROUP_NAME_RE no longer accepts acme-corp")
import kb_mcp
listed,handlers=kb_mcp.group_tools()
need(len(listed)==1, ("tools served for group acme-corp", listed))

import json,os,sys,tempfile,pathlib,re
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
T=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
e=T/"ext"; e.mkdir()
(e/"gt.py").write_text("KBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=0.1\"\ndef hello(args):\n    return \"hi\"\nTOOLS=[{\"name\":\"hello\",\"description\":\"say hi\",\"inputSchema\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{}},\"call\":hello}]\n")
(T/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"group":"acme-corp","extensions":{"mcp_tools":"gt:TOOLS"},"extension_paths":[str(e)]}))
os.environ["CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"]=str(T)
import kb_mcp
listed,handlers=kb_mcp.group_tools()
if not listed:
    sys.exit("not yet: no tool served for group acme-corp")
bad=[t["name"] for t in listed if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}", t["name"])]
sys.exit("not yet: tool names not valid MCP names: "+repr(bad) if bad else 0)

import re,sys
t=open("kb/_self/extending.md",encoding="utf-8").read()
sys.exit(0 if re.search(r"prefix[^\n]*hyphen|hyphen[^\n]*prefix", t) else "not yet: extending.md states no prefix rule for a hyphenated group name")

gates.question: How does kb_mcp.py prefix the tools of a group whose name has a hyphen?
options: turn each hyphen into an underscore
gates.reason: no collision between acme-corp and acme_corp, a valid MCP name, and the tool name still shows the group as written
